meta_description:
27K likes, 772 comments - thefitnesschef_ on January 2, 2024: "My brand new app is FINALLY live on Apple & Google app stores🙏. I’m doing a launch offer where you can save 40% on annual subscriptions if you sign up before 9/1/24 - link in bio ⤴️.⁣
⁣
I’ve invested everything (financially and emotionally) into this app. My goal is to ultimately help millions of people ditch unsustainable, restrictive diets and use my app as a tool to eat what they love, maintain a positive relationship with food and get lasting results.⁣
⁣
Whether you want to lose fat, build muscle, maintain or improve diet quality and exercise, my app will help you focus on what’s important. You’ll be able to track your diet accurately and be empowered to focus on what actually matters in a sustainable way for your goal.⁣
⁣
The launch offer is available until 9th January, 2024! Simply tap the link in my bio, sign up, download the app and sign in. You get a 14 day free trial too 🙌.⁣
⁣
If you’re an existing subscriber to the web app, simply download the brand new mobile app and sign in. You’ll continue paying the same rates you did before. 😏⁣
⁣
There may be one or two bugs as the app is in its infancy, but these will be quickly resolved by the team who are working hard.⁣
⁣
This is just the start. Brand new improvements and features are coming soon! What are you waiting for? 🙏⁣
⁣
#diet #caloriecounting #fatloss".
